When the POWERTRAIN Coverage Plan has been purchased as indicated on the Information Schedule, only the following parts are
covered.

Assembly Parts Covered

– All of the above listed parts or equivalent plus: Bypass valve, Clutch
and pulley, Compressor, Hard lines, Injection pump, Intercooler, Lines and nozzles, Supercharger, Turbocharger, Waste gate controller.
